content: Wagangan Sudorodu Boubei
Ingiese Huda bijiende ubali xiizhi ene renwui ogise bijien zhughe ulie widane.

Khareidene niuighazhi giesan shizheku shiqinyi bendawo. Piendaku shiqin ulie giezhi Hudai daolii ulie wirulaghane. Zhendaoni qinchude kieliezhi Hudai melie jien lianxintu kunlade goyane jieshao giene.
Bijien chonjisan gouxioxii khaghazhoshi widachen kunlade khaghazho.
Ene duyai Ibilisi enezighan xianxin ulie giechen kunlai nudunyi sugho gholughazhi gouxioxii gonni ese chanlaghazho. Ene gouxioxide Mexihai famani kieliezho. Mexihashi Hudai yanzi wo.
Bijien chonjisanshi goyane pusho. Ersa Mexihashi Ezhan bikui, pse Ersade oluzhi tande hoji danlasanni chonjizho.
"Kharanise gon khizhe" giezhi kieliesan Huda Ersa Mexihai khizha jieredu goya famane mejieghaku gonni mai zhughede zhouighazho.
Bijiende ene boubei winema, bijienshi zinie boubei teiku wagangan wo. Ingiekushi tebieji fugie nenlishi bijiennughun pusho Hudanughun bikui mejieghane giezho.
Bijienyi simiense daruzhoma, daruzhi yama giegha dazho. Zhughede kunnan winema, xiwon ese widazho.
Heizhoma, Huda bijienyi ese bendazho. Eghi unaghazhoma, eghizhi ala dazho.
Bijien beye jierene Ersani duya ijiekui chan deilakushi Ersani aminni bijienyi jiereye xienjizhi khizheghane giezho.
Bijien amitukude Ersani yenyinghala chan fuguku wixien dunda wo. Ingiekushi Ersani aminyi bijienyi fuguku beye jiere xienjizhi khizheghane giezho.
Ingie uzhese fuguku bijienyi jiere ochirazho, amin tai jiere ochirazho.
Jinwun jiere, "Bi xianxin giezho, ingiese bi kieliezho." giezhi huaisan mutun bijiendeye xianxianji xianxin gieku wine, ingiese bijien xianxin giedene kieliezho.
Ezhan Ersai aminne olughasan hhe bijienyiye Ersare hhantu aminne olughazhi bijienyi tanre hhantu hhei melie beighakui bijien mejiene.
Enelashi man tande oluzhi giezho. Ingiese nenjien yebeiseye olon kunlade echizhi mafan gieku zhughe olodozhi kuaikui Hudade ogine.
Xianxin Giekui Kouizhi Udu Dao
Ingiese bijien zhughe ulie widane. Bijienyi beye goujijia qida olunema, zhughe niudunie shinishizho.
Bijienyi zhanshi jieredu gongien kunnan jianlai ireku hashu witu chanqiku fugie famani chenjighane.
Bijien gonxin giekushi chanlaku pusho, chanla daku wo. Chanlakushi niechaku wo, chanla dakushi chanqiku wo.
